title: Mid-Semester Examination Schedule for Semester 7 Announced
author: Controller of Examinations
description: The Mid-Semester Theory and Practical examinations for B.Tech Semester 7 will commence from October 12, 2026. Detailed seating arrangements and slot timings will be published on the university portal next week.

title: Microsoft Campus Recruitment Drive 2026 Registration Open
author: Training & Placement Cell
description: Microsoft is visiting for the role of Software Development Engineer (SDE-1) offering 44.5 LPA. Eligible students (B.Tech CSE/IT with CGPA >= 7.5 and no active backlogs) must apply through the placement portal by September 28, 2026.

title: Campus Hackathon: GenAI & MCP Innovation Challenge 2026
author: Department of Computer Science
description: Registrations are now open for the annual 36-hour Hackathon focusing on Generative AI, Model Context Protocol, and Autonomous Agents. Cash prizes worth 2.5 Lakhs. Team size: 2-4 members.

title: Submission of Capstone Project Phase 1 Synopsis & Architecture
author: Project Coordination Committee
description: All final year B.Tech students are instructed to submit their Capstone Project Phase 1 Synopsis along with system architecture diagrams to their respective project guides on or before September 30, 2026.

title: Guest Lecture on Generative AI & Model Context Protocol (MCP) by Google
author: AI & Robotics Club
description: Join us this Friday at 02:30 PM in Auditorium Hall 1 for an insightful keynote on 'Building Enterprise Multi-Agent Workflows with MCP' delivered by senior engineers from Google.

title: Central Library Extended Reading Room Hours for Exam Season
author: Chief Librarian
description: In view of upcoming mid-term exams, the Central Digital Library and 24/7 Study Lounge will remain open until 2:00 AM on weekdays starting October 1st. Digital access to IEEE Xplore and ACM Digital Library remains active.

title: Inter-University Annual Sports Meet 'Olympus 2026' Trials
author: Department of Physical Education
description: University sports selection trials for Cricket, Football, Basketball, and Table Tennis will be held on September 26-27 at the University Sports Complex. Registered players must report with sports kit by 08:00 AM.

title: Google Cloud & AWS Student Certification Reimbursement Scheme
author: Dean Academic Affairs
description: Under the University Skill Enhancement Initiative, students passing Associate Cloud Engineer or AWS Solutions Architect exams will receive a 75% fee reimbursement upon submitting their passing scorecards.

title: Urgent: Mandatory Academic Feedback Form for Faculty Evaluation
author: Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
description: All 7th-semester students must complete the mid-semester faculty and course evaluation feedback on the ERP portal before admit cards are issued for the mid-term examinations.
